title: Yuanjiajie - the Avatar Mountains
text: Yuanjiajie is the plateau where the famous floating mountains are visible - the most visited section of the park. Reach it via Bailong Elevator (65 yuan) or the shuttle from Tianzi cable car. Key spots: Hallelujah Avatar Pillar, Back Garden, First Bridge Under Heaven.

title: Tianzi Mountain - the Emperor's Mountain
text: Tianzi Mountain at 1,262 m is the highest part of the park, named where a Tujia chief declared himself emperor. Reach it by cable car (72 yuan, 10 min) or on foot via 8,000 steps. Highlights: Imperial Brush pillar (on the 100-yuan note!), Helong Park and Western Sea.

title: A rainy day in Zhangjiajie - what to do
text: Rain is not a reason to stay in the hotel - fog and rain create the iconic Avatar floating mountain effect that photographers wait for. Great rainy options: Yuanjiajie viewpoints, Golden Whip Stream with swollen waterfalls. Skip the Glass Bridge when slippery.

title: Hidden trails - secrets of the park
text: Most tourists stick to the same routes. Escape the crowds at Yangjiajie (Great Wall-like ridge with a fraction of the visitors), remote Laowuchang with sky-top terraced rice fields, the original Huangshizhai plateau, or the 5-6 km forest path from Bailong to Tianzi Mountain.

title: Getting around inside the park
text: The park covers 369 km2 - you cannot walk it all. The 65-yuan transport ticket includes free shuttle buses on upper and lower loops (every 5-15 minutes until ~18:00). Cable cars go to Huangshizhai (65 yuan), Yangjiajie (76 yuan) and Tianzi Mountain (72 yuan).
